permanent_ribs.purpose: support the shelf-flange transition in print; retain inside chamber

V100_cooling_module.support: continuous sidewalls into6mm base; three M4 shelf bolts carry fan and hood; flex duct separately supported
V100_cooling_module.shelf_hardware: 3 M4x16 bolts,3 nuts,6 OD12x1 steel washers; verify actual stack
V100_cooling_module.rear_IO_fit: high-X sidewall requires dry fit against Berserk rear ports and any fitted shield; exact bodies unmeasured
V100_cooling_module.material: Polymaker HT-PLA-GF; 0.4mm hardened steel nozzle;230C nozzle/50C bed
V100_cooling_module.nut: M4 2020 hammer T-nut; rectangular back-loaded pocket; no extra cap
V100_cooling_module.nut_fit: selected Sutemribor dimensions unverified; print job13 nut coupon first; 12.2x6.4x4.8 pocket is provisional
V100_cooling_module.inlet_hardware: 4 M4x14 socket-cap screws,4 M4 T-nuts,4 OD9x1 washers; clamp only inlet flange
V100_cooling_module.joint_hardware: none; fan panel is integral with shroud
V100_cooling_module.assembly_order: fit-test nut coupon; load four fan nuts; tighten Kenshin front motherboard anchors first; lower bare hood over rear array; fix three internal M4 shelf bolts through open fan aperture using long driver, before fan/duct; seal common inlet/underside with secured nonconductive flexible gasket; install fan then separately supported duct
V100_cooling_module.print_orientation: integral fan face down, rotated90deg in XY; four permanent tapered chamber ribs; no removable supports in job11
V100_cooling_module.seal: broad secured flexible nonconductive foam/tape skirt across common lower opening and front/side perimeter; keep GPU vents open and exclude PCB contacts; seal all bypasses before thermal testing
V100_cooling_module.airflow: four V100 heatsinks to common plenum, pull fan, flexible duct and inner-ceiling chamber; actual pressure/flow and temperatures require load testing
V100_cooling_module.ratings_limit: free-air and shutoff endpoints are not operating airflow; no thermal qualification yet
V100_cooling_module.anneal: see saved manufacturer TDS; check dimensions after annealing; unloaded heat stability is not a loaded bracket rating
